commands.name: cli-plugin-version
commands.run:
version=$(python3 -c 'import json, pathlib, re; config = json.loads(pathlib.Path(".github/release.json").read_text()); print(re.search(config["version_pattern"], pathlib.Path(config["version_file"]).read_text())[1])')
swift build -c release
bin=$(swift build -c release --show-bin-path)
test "$("$bin/swift-benchmark-cli" --version)" = "swift-benchmark-cli $version"
test "$("$bin/BenchmarkCLI" --version)" = "swift-benchmark-cli $version"
test "$(swift package --configuration release benchmark --version)" = "swift-benchmark-cli $version"
